preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The angle a must be between 1 and 180 degrees inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly three space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each of the three integers in the output must be a valid vertex number between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: abs((360 / n) * abs(int(stdout.split()[0]) - int(stdout.split()[2])) - a) <= min(abs((360 / n) * abs(i - j) - a) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) if i != j)
postconditions.description: The angle formed by the vertices must be as close as possible to the given angle a.
